evals.name: alb-502-no-deploy
evals.prompt: The checkout API returns 502 Bad Gateway since 08:10 this morning, only in production, and nothing was deployed. Logs are in logs/ (the load balancer and the service), deploy history in deploy/, the k8s manifest in k8s/. Find which layer is failing, with evidence, and tell me the next action. Do not change any files.
evals.expected_output: A three-line verdict: Layer config (memory limit) or capacity, evidence the pod was OOMKilled at 08:09:58 and the restart hit EADDRINUSE, next action raise the limit / fix the restart; not an auth or code fix.

checks.text: Final reply contains the 'Layer:' verdict line
The named layer is config/capacity (OOM limit) or network (gateway cannot reach the target), not auth or code
Verdict names the OOM kill or the port clash as the cause
Does not propose an auth fix

expectations: Phase 1 done: three lines are written down before any diagnosis: the verbatim first error line, where it surfaced, when it started.
Phase 2 done: exactly one layer is named from the table and its diagnostic is spelled out as a runnable command or a specific log check, with the real values filled in.

Phase 3 done: one diagnostic at a time; every layer ruled out has a one-line note with the evidence that ruled it out; the confirmed layer is backed by the diagnostic's own output (a log line quoted or a command run).
Phase 4 done: the three-line verdict (Layer / Evidence / Next) is in the reply and either the fix was named or one owning skill was called, not both.
